decision_scope: P0 INITIALIZE WINDOWS - single canonical decision for this pipeline run

files_to_create_notes.layout_precedent: identical scaffold verified on Windows9-12 P0-init branches: WindowsN/{README.md, _state/{research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl, research_ledger.md, agent_log.md}, selection_history/, final_ideas/, artifacts/}; window.lock.json is NEW this round (zero lock files exist on any ref) and lives at Windows13/_state/window.lock.json per judge_C ruling
files_to_create_notes.ideas_master_jsonl_init: empty 0-byte file (Windows9/11/12 convention); one JSON object per idea appended later
files_to_create_notes.selection_history_policy: lazy per-stage evidence files; .gitkeep only at init (Windows4/6 precedent)
files_to_create_notes.json_validity_gate: Implementation MUST validate every .json with python3 -m json.tool before committing (Windows11 research_state.json on origin is malformed JSON - do not repeat)

research_state_required_fields.note: these fields are additive on top of the Windows12-schema base fields (repository, branch, base_branch, created_at, supervisor, current_stage='Stage 1', target_pipeline, total_ideas=0, survivors=0, final_target=3, status='initialized', numbering evidence block, git_safety block, ideas_index=[], current_ranking=[], evidence_policy)

window_lock_json_required_fields.write_policy: written with locked=true inside the init commit itself, immediately after the final re-fetch + overwrite check passes; worker_C's two-phase create-unlocked design is OVERRULED (judge_C ruling C1, ratified here); a committed-unlocked lock invites sibling claims and the P1 gate is already blocked waiting for exactly one authoritative locked file

commit_message_notes: matches dominant 'Research Idea Evolution - WindowsN - <action>' family with no space before N; dispatcher template takes precedence over the 'Initialize WindowsN research workspace (P0)' form used by Windows9-12; a follow-up commit recording the verified push SHA is permitted per Windows9-12 practice; if the number is bumped at implementation time, substitute the bumped N in the message
overwrite_check: No overwrite target exists: origin/main tree contains only README.md and has never contained any WindowsN path; Windows13 is absent from every origin head tree, every branch name, and every commit message across all refs as of the consolidator re-fetch at 2026-08-28T17:23:33Z; no window.lock.json exists anywhere on any ref; no variant spellings of Windows13 found; reusing occupied numbers 2,3,4,6,8,9,10,11,12 is forbidden (live unmerged cursor/* branches would collide at merge time); in-repo secret scan clean per worker_B and judge_B (65 commits, all refs). Residual risk is the numbering race only, mitigated by numbering_race_policy.
numbering_race_policy: Implementation MUST run 'git fetch origin --prune' immediately before mkdir and re-verify on the freshly fetched refs that Windows13 (directory, branch name, commit message, research_state windows_id, or window.lock.json claim) does not exist on ANY origin tip. If Windows13 already exists on any origin tip, bump to the smallest unused N strictly greater than 13 that is absent from every origin tip, and substitute that N everywhere (windows_id, windows_path, all file paths, research_state.json, window.lock.json, commit message). Never gap-fill 1, 5, or 7 (never-existed/burned per ledger records) and never reuse burned numbers 2, 3 (staging/Windows3_supervisor counts as burned), 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12. Perform fetch -> verify -> create -> commit -> push as one fast sequence; never force-push. Known active siblings at decision time: family '_state/tasks/p0/windows_init/' targets Windows14 primary and explicitly defers Windows13 to this run; families '_dispatcher/p0/wave_a/' and '_state/tasks/P0/wave_A/' were still in Wave A (no claim) as of 17:23:33Z.
